category: Standalone VR / Mixed Reality Headset (Color Passthrough)

computeArchitecture.coprocessor: Integrated Sensor Hub (handles IMU, controller tracking, mixed reality depth)
computeArchitecture.cooling: Active fan cooling with thermal dissipation channels

displayAndOptics.opticsType: Pancake Lenses (folded optics — thinner than Fresnel)
displayAndOptics.passthroughCameras: 2x high-resolution RGB cameras (full-color mixed reality passthrough)
displayAndOptics.visionCorrection: Third-party magnetic prescription lens inserts (Zenni Optical, FramesDirect partnership)

physicalAttributes.formFactor: Head-mounted VR/MR headset with integrated head strap

connectivity.wifi: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax — 6 GHz band for low-latency wireless PC streaming)
connectivity.usbC: USB Type-C (USB 3.0) — charging, Oculus Link wired PC VR, data transfer

audio.speakers: Integrated open-ear stereo speakers (3D spatial audio)

sensorsAndTracking.trackingDegreesOfFreedom: 6DoF inside-out positional tracking (no external base stations required)
sensorsAndTracking.depthSensor: Depth projector (for spatial mesh, mixed reality occlusion)
features: Bare-hand direct touch tracking (Direct Touch Hand Engine)
Mixed reality depth occlusion (objects behind real surfaces)
Touch Plus controllers (6DoF ring-free motion controllers)
sensorsAndTracking.primaryInput: Touch Plus controllers + bare-hand direct touch tracking + voice

softwareAndEcosystem.appStore: Meta Quest Store + App Lab + SideQuest (sideloading)
softwareAndEcosystem.pcVR: Oculus Link (wired USB-C) / AirLink (Wi-Fi 6E wireless) for SteamVR and Meta PC VR
features: Direct Touch hand engine (no controllers required)
Spatial content casting to TV or PC
Voice commands via Meta AI assistant

simulationProfile.note: Baseline reference device in the AuraBeat matrix. Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 performs well for standalone VR but is outpaced by split-compute and newer architectures. Used as 1.0x speed reference.
simulationProfile.ppdWarningNote: Display density is ~20.0 PPD (below the 30 PPD clarity threshold). AuraBeat automatically expands UI font size by +14% when this hardware profile is selected to preserve spatial text legibility.
